name: github
title: GitHub
description: Search repositories with local fuzzy fallback, browse and open your repos, manage issues, pull requests, workflows and notifications.
author: black

commands.name: search-repositories
commands.title: Search Repositories
commands.subtitle: Find any repository on GitHub
commands.description: Search all public and private repositories, with local fuzzy ranking over the results.

commands.name: my-repositories
commands.title: My Repositories
commands.subtitle: Browse repositories you own or starred
commands.description: Browse the repositories you own or have starred, filtered locally and instantly.

commands.name: search-issues
commands.title: Search Issues
commands.subtitle: Find issues across GitHub
commands.description: Search issues across all repositories you can see, with author, label and state filters.

commands.name: search-pull-requests
commands.title: Search Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: Find pull requests across GitHub
commands.description: Search pull requests across all repositories you can see, with state and author filters.

commands.name: create-issue
commands.title: Create Issue
commands.subtitle: Open a new issue
commands.description: Open a new issue in a repository, optionally from a template.

commands.name: create-pull-request
commands.title: Create Pull Request
commands.subtitle: Open a new pull request
commands.description: Open a new pull request between two branches in a repository.

commands.name: create-branch
commands.title: Create Branch
commands.subtitle: Branch off an existing one
commands.description: Create a new branch from any existing branch in a repository.

commands.name: workflow-runs
commands.title: Workflow Runs
commands.subtitle: Inspect and control CI runs
commands.description: List workflow runs for a repository, with the job breakdown and cancel and rerun actions.

commands.name: notifications
commands.title: Notifications
commands.subtitle: Work through your inbox
commands.description: List your GitHub notifications and mark them read or done without leaving the keyboard.

commands.name: rerun-workflow-run
commands.title: Rerun Workflow Run
commands.subtitle: Retry a CI job
commands.description: Rerun a workflow run, optionally re-running only the failed jobs.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: A personal access token. Fine-grained tokens need repository read access plus notifications and workflow scopes.

preferences.name: numberOfResults
preferences.title: Results per page
preferences.description: How many results to request per page, from 10 to 100. GitHub allows at most 100.

preferences.name: defaultRepositoryScope
preferences.title: Default Repository Scope
preferences.description: Which repositories the My Repositories command starts on.

preferences.name: includeForks
preferences.title: Options
preferences.description: Controls which repositories GitHub search returns.
preferences.label: Include forks

preferences.name: includeArchived
preferences.title: Options
preferences.description: Controls which repositories GitHub search returns.
preferences.label: Include archived

preferences.name: defaultEditor
preferences.title: Open Repositories In
preferences.description: The application used by the Open in Editor action, which clones the repository first if needed. Emacs, Neovim, Vim and Helix are terminal programs and are opened in a terminal window. Choose none to hide that action; Clone still works.

preferences.name: cloneDirectory
preferences.title: Clone Directory
preferences.description: Where Open in Editor clones a repository that is not already present. A leading ~ expands to your home directory.

scripts.test: tsx test/search-query.test.ts && tsx test/format.test.ts && tsx test/parsing.test.ts && tsx test/readme-images.test.ts
